post.originalText:
SIMPLY INSANE RESULTS FROM THE FOUR GIANTS

Four top-tier AI models were given the exact same prompt: generate a 3D night scene of a train crossing a stone mountain bridge. Here are the results:

• Gemini 4 Argon (4 min 20 sec | $3.40) - The undisputed winner. Great movement physics, clean geometry, and zero artifacts in record time.

• GPT-6 Astra (19 min 31 sec | $5.18) - Cinematic lighting and a clean visual style, though the environment lacked a bit of density and texture.

• Claude Opus 5.5 (26 min 56 sec | $5.53) - Maximum detailing. Incredible stonework and train textures, but it took nearly half an hour to render.

• Claude Sonnet 5.5 (2 hr 40 min | $18.80) - An efficiency fail. The output was on par with Opus but took almost 3 hours and cost 5.5x more than Gemini.

Gemini delivers unbelievable speed without sacrificing quality, while Opus remains the go-to for those who need pixel-perfect micro-details.

Would you switch to Gemini for that insane speed, or are you still sticking with Claude for the details? I’m waiting for the answer in the comments.

Bookmark this post so you know exactly which AI to choose for your next 3D project!
